commit.message:
Prepare first CRAN submission (reviewer-facing files)

DESCRIPTION: quote software names in Title, quote bare 'ODK' in
Description, declare GPL-3 with the new LICENSE file (DBCA, 2026),
canonical pkgdown URL. New LICENSE file. Document the four print
methods with server-free runnable examples. Fix flagged URLs (OData
Oasis http to https, dead ODK Build link to XLSForm, fake Central
hosts to example.com/net, dead blog/forum/docker links in NEWS,
tmap vignette and my-instance links, Sweave/Shiny Posit links).
Rewrite cran-comments for first submission; ignore justfile in the
build.
